_comment: Release-flow gate configuration (seven stages P0-P6; authoritative standard is gcat-std/RELEASE-FLOW.md). Commands run as an argv list (shlex.split, not through a shell) — see the gcat-std red line. ⚠️ No `repo` field (a local machine path is a privacy red line): pass it at runtime via `--repo <path>`.

P0.gate: Plan: PRD + acceptance-criteria table + won't-do list + task breakdown table

P1.gate: Workspace development: changes landed + committed separately (never touch staging/remote)

P2.gate: Local tests: all green + counter-evidence + contracts

P3.gate: Deploy: backup is restorable + minimal footprint + service self-reports version + rollback drill

P4.gate: Production testing: real end-to-end exercise + real-data verification + test-artifact cleanup

commands.name: Production smoke test (layered-write four-shot verification + DB check + cleanup)

P5.gate: Release: version consistent in all three places + zero privacy-scan output + independent clone re-scan + open-source ready

P6.gate: Wrap-up: CHANGELOG + backlink pointers + memory + ledger + the delivery trio
